name: Erik Andersson
bio:
Erik's journey into motorsport started early, fueled by a childhood fascination with rally racing. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics and performance. After graduating, he landed a junior engineering role at a smaller racing outfit before quickly demonstrating a knack for team management and strategic decision-making. His ability to analyze complex situations and implement effective solutions earned him the Sporting Director role at Target Racing.

Erik is known for his data-driven approach, meticulously studying race telemetry and competitor performance to identify areas for improvement. He fosters a collaborative environment within the team, encouraging open communication and knowledge sharing. While relatively young for the position, Erik's blend of technical expertise and managerial acumen makes him a rising star in the motorsport world.

He believes that consistent, incremental improvements, based on solid analysis, are the key to long-term success. Erik is also particularly adept at managing driver egos, ensuring that individual ambitions align with the overall team goals.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Erik is of average height with a lean build and intense blue eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Swedish coffee before every race.
